U.P. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The FIR in question was lodged stating that the victim and the accused were in love with each other and while engaging in physical relation, a video was made by the accused and thereafter,
threatened to make the video viral and demanded the money.
Subsequently in the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., she stated that physical relation was formed without her consent.
In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., she stated that on account of the video, she was being blackmailed by the applicant.
The victim had refused to undergo any medical examination.
The applicant is in custody since 18.09.2022 and has no criminal antecedents.

3. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

4. Considering the allegations levelled in the FIR, prima facie, no offence under Section 376 IPC was mentioned in the FIR, the version of FIR was changed in the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
and in the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the medical report does not corroborate the allegation of the victim, even the date and time was not mentioned in the statement, the age of the victim is 34 years, there is huge variance in the statements, the applicant is in custody since 18.09.2022 and has no criminal antecedents, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
5. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Gopal Gupta alias Krishna be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.491 of 2022, under Sections 376, 384, 506 IPC and Section 66E IT Act, Police Statin Kotwali Dehat,
District Bahraich on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:

( a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
